MANGA MARKETSQUARE Return Policy

Transparent returns backed by 100% verified seller guarantees

1. 7-Day Return Guarantee

We want you to be 100% satisfied with your purchases. Any item purchased on MANGA MARKETSQUARE from verified merchants may be returned within 7 calendar days from the delivery date, provided it is unused and in its original retail packaging.

2. Eligible Return Reasons

  • Item delivered is defective, malfunctioning, or damaged in transit.
  • Item received differs from product specifications.
  • Wrong item, size, color, or missing components delivered.

3. Return Process & Pickup

Initiating a return is simple: go to your Account → Orders, select the order, and tap "Request Return / Help". For orders within Kaduna, our local courier fleet can arrange doorstep pickup.

Verified Marketplace Sellers

All merchants undergo strict identity and document verification before listing.

Same-Day Delivery in Kaduna

Same-day delivery is possible for orders within Kaduna, with reliable delivery nationwide.
